IRIB Voice of I.Radio Iran FAQ

What frequency is IRIB Voice of I.Radio Iran on?
In the B-26 season IRIB Voice of I.Radio Iran is scheduled on 38 shortwave frequencies, including 5905, 5970, 6000, 7280, 9570, 9640 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 7280 kHz (7:50 pm – 9:20 pm Eastern). For Europe: 5905 kHz (7:20 pm – 8:20 pm UTC+1).

What time is IRIB Voice of I.Radio Iran on shortwave?
IRIB Voice of I.Radio Iran is scheduled in 23 UTC time windows this season, from 00:50–02:20 UTC through 19:20–20:20 UTC. English broadcasts: 19:20–20:20 UTC; 15:20–16:20 UTC. All times are UTC; subtract your UTC offset for local time.

Can I hear IRIB Voice of I.Radio Iran in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 7280 kHz (7:50 pm – 9:20 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does IRIB Voice of I.Radio Iran broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 9855 kHz at 19:20–20:20 UTC to S. Africa; 11640 kHz at 15:20–16:20 UTC to South Asia; 11710 kHz at 15:20–16:20 UTC to South Asia; 11740 kHz at 19:20–20:20 UTC to S. Africa; 11880 kHz at 19:20–20:20 UTC to S. Africa; plus 1 more.

Is IRIB Voice of I.Radio Iran on the air right now?
As of Wednesday, November 11, 2026, 12:42 UTC, IRIB Voice of I.Radio Iran is scheduled to be broadcasting on 9790 kHz to Central Asia. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
